Text:
[II] Christ the Lord, who died and rose again, is ceaseless in His intercessions for us. Therefore, with confidence, we pray:
[IR] Victorious King, hear us.
[I1] Christ, the light and salvation of all peoples,
[I2] pour the fire of Your Spirit upon us as our lives proclaim Your resurrection.
[I1] May Israel recognize You as the Messiah, the fullness of their hope,
[I2] and may the knowledge of Your glory fill the vastness of creation.
[I1] Welcome and keep us in the communion of Your saints,
[I2] and let us find rest, with them, from our work.
[I1] You, who triumphed over the enemy of death, break the enemies power within us,
[I2] that we may live for You, immortal victor.
[I1] Christ the Savior, Your obedience led You to death, and to be exalted to the right hand of the Father,
[I2] graciously welcome Your siblings into the Kingdom of Your glory.
